scientific_question: Is selective attenuation of finite-amplitude curvature that opposes the network's own first-order policy value sufficient to recover local fidelity while preserving the frozen global relational mechanism?
core_hypothesis: The frozen seed-2101 fast-weight backbone already carries query-bound useful first-order value, but finite-amplitude tanh curvature sometimes opposes that value in output-margin geometry. A policy-relative sign-aware controller should attenuate only those opposed corrections rather than all large curvature.
theoretical_identity: This is a policy-relative curvature-opposition controller. Its online state is g(P_T, h0, b, W_margin), not a hidden-space-only saturation detector.
claim_boundary: This is a one-backbone development sufficiency test. It does not confirm population-level v2, identify a biological controller, prove that the gate estimates an offline crossing, change tanh, introduce a new memory channel, or permit end-to-end co-adaptation. A valid failure closes the scalar amplitude-gating family rather than shrinking the supported fast-weight global-assembly claim.
registration_timing: The contract is frozen after the unsigned curvature-risk v2 pilot failed and before writing the v2.1 implementation, adapting its parameter, or evaluating any v2.1 condition.

frozen_backbone_contract.origin: final step-1000 v1 backbone produced under curvature_gate_pilot_v2
frozen_backbone_contract.reuse_only: Do not retrain or edit the backbone. Freeze every backbone tensor before v2.1 gate adaptation and verify byte identity afterward.

execution_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for gate adaptation and neural replay
execution_contract.trial_input_transfer: one contiguous CPU-to-GPU transfer per trial
execution_contract.implementation_freeze: The v2.1 implementation and tests must be committed after this protocol and before gate adaptation. An execution lock must record exact source hashes and refuse mismatches.
execution_contract.seed_subject_relation_or_trial_filtering: forbidden except the prospectively defined stable-omission retained-evidence mask

gate_equation.scope: only the first fast-weight-sensitive response transition of a query; support dynamics, fast-weight writes, and all later unused query steps remain frozen v1
gate_equation.quadratic_curvature: K2(b,u) = -tanh(b) elementwise-multiplied by (1 - tanh(b)^2) elementwise-multiplied by u^2
gate_equation.beta_constraint: beta = softplus(raw_beta) and raw_beta is the only trainable v2.1 parameter
gate_equation.small_j_safeguard_rationale: The fixed relative-scale term prevents rare near-zero projected first-order values from controlling adaptation without introducing any Liu-derived scale or fitted cap.
gate_equation.online_inputs_only: P_T, current query-derived h0, x_response, and frozen backbone parameters including W_margin
gate_equation.forbidden_inputs: relation identity, H>A indicator, true label, correctness, LOO state, posterior, offline crossing bracket, subject identifier, or Liu-derived statistic

gate_only_adaptation.backbone: load the frozen seed-2101 checkpoint and freeze every v1 parameter
gate_only_adaptation.task_distribution: the same generic sparse ranking distribution with the Liu graph and rank-axis reflection excluded
gate_only_adaptation.loss: mean generic query cross-entropy under r_opp; no Liu term, crossing target, human scalar, relation label, or auxiliary gate target
gate_only_adaptation.sign_reversed_training: none; r_support reuses the exact beta learned for r_opp and adds no free parameter

matched_global_calibration.definition: gamma_global is the arithmetic mean of opposition gamma over every subject and query in an independent generic calibration stream after beta is frozen
matched_global_calibration.graph_distribution: identical to gate adaptation and excluding Liu plus its reflection
matched_global_calibration.freeze_timing: gamma_global is written to the v2.1 gate artifact before any Liu evaluation and is never refit

liu_evaluation.randomness_reuse_rationale: Reuse the frozen v2 Liu evaluation draws to isolate the online statistic; none are used for parameter adaptation or calibration.

conditions.original_v1: gamma=1 with the frozen seed-2101 backbone
conditions.opposition_gate: gamma is computed online from matched-query r_opp
conditions.matched_global_scalar: every query uses the pre-Liu frozen gamma_global
conditions.shuffled_opposition_gate: within subject, permute opposition gamma across the 56 fixed oriented queries; reuse the same query permutation for intact and every relation-LOO replay
conditions.sign_reversed_support_gate: use r_support with the exact opposition-trained beta and otherwise identical equation and state

estimand_contract.local_field: For each retained support relation q, subtract relation-LOO logits from intact logits on all 28 pairs in both orientations, antisymmetrize, and apply the complete-graph Hodge residual projector.
estimand_contract.direct_correctness: Multiply the Hodge residual on q's direct edge by the registered correct orientation sign.
primary_local_estimands: within-subject mean direct correctness over the other seven retained relations
estimand_contract.remote_reassembly: For each retained q, average absolute intact-minus-LOO influence over disjoint query pairs and average within subject before bootstrap.
estimand_contract.third_party_reassembly: Use the gauge-invariant third-party relational potential-energy fraction from the registered assembly definition and average retained relations within subject.
estimand_contract.query_binding: Matched normalized operator-action gain minus shared-endpoint mismatch and disjoint mismatch, using the registered state-query operator definition before gated tanh.
estimand_contract.terminal_projection: Opposition-gated final neural-potential cosine to exact posterior expected-rank/Hodge potential minus cosine to exact MAP potential.
estimand_contract.crossing_susceptibility: Reuse the frozen 0.00 to 1.00 amplitude grid in increments of 0.05. Spearman correlation between opposition gamma and LOO crossing midpoint is descriptive only and never enters PASS/FAIL.
estimand_contract.gate_allocation: Report j, k, opposition/support risk and gamma by relation, including H>A and F>A, plus the fraction of states with j*k below, above, or equal to zero.
estimand_contract.behavioral_consequences: Report learned accuracy, nonlearned accuracy, overall accuracy, and symbolic-distance slope for all five conditions; no human interval is a primary gate.

competence_and_integrity_gates.backbone: The original-v1 condition must pass qualification_v2 before the gate result is interpreted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: Every registered source, implementation source, backbone checkpoint, gate artifact, and matched scalar must match its recorded SHA-256.
competence_and_integrity_gates.frozen_backbone: Only raw_beta may change during adaptation; every v1 state-dict tensor must be byte-identical before and after.
competence_and_integrity_gates.gate_equivalence: original_v1 must reproduce ungated backbone logits within 1e-6.
competence_and_integrity_gates.risk_identity: For every finite evaluated state, r_opp and r_support are nonnegative; when j*k is positive r_opp is exactly zero, and when j*k is negative r_support is exactly zero, within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.stable_omission: Relation-LOO influence and direct correctness must be zero within 1e-7 when the relation was already omitted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.shuffle_integrity: Shuffled opposition gamma must preserve each subject's 56-value multiset within 1e-7 and change at least one assignment for every subject with nonconstant gamma.
competence_and_integrity_gates.matched_scalar_integrity: Stored gamma_global must equal the independently replayed generic calibration mean within 1e-7.
competence_and_integrity_gates.sign_reversed_integrity: The sign-reversed condition must use the same beta, denominator, state, and response mapping as opposition, differing only by relu(+j*k) versus relu(-j*k).

primary_decision_rules.local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for opposition minus original retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.control_specificity: Each paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for opposition minus matched-global, opposition minus shuffled-opposition, and opposition minus sign-reversed-support retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for opposition minus original H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and H>A under opposition is not robustly wrong-sign: its bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
primary_decision_rules.preserve_other_relations: The opposition-minus-original mean over the other seven retained relations has a paired-bootstrap lower bound no smaller than -0.01.
primary_decision_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Opposition nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and no more than 0.02 below original v1.
primary_decision_rules.fast_weight_necessity: The opposition condition passes every qualification_v2 intervention and order-invariance rule.
primary_decision_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Opposition remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original v1.
primary_decision_rules.query_binding_preservation: Both opposition matched-minus-mismatch normalized operator-gain contrasts remain positive and equal original within 1e-7 because the estimand is pre-gate.
primary_decision_rules.terminal_projection_preservation: The opposition expected-rank-minus-MAP participant-bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero.
primary_decision_rules.crossing_correlation_not_a_gate: Spearman(gamma, offline crossing midpoint) is reported as a mechanistic diagnostic but cannot pass or fail the candidate.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.all_primary_rules_pass: Selective attenuation of policy-opposed curvature is sufficient on the frozen seed-2101 backbone. Freeze a separate 2102/2103 replication contract before any new seed; do not begin end-to-end co-adaptation.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.valid_local_or_specificity_failure: Close the scalar amplitude-gating family. Do not invent a more complex risk metric, run 2102/2103, change tanh, or co-adapt end-to-end. Register a residualized or near-linear expression candidate that explicitly preserves a local J_bu branch on this same frozen backbone.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.local_rescue_with_global_failure: Reject the candidate because it trades supported global assembly for local fidelity; close scalar amplitude gating and move to the registered near-linear/residualized route.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.competence_or_integrity_failure: The mechanistic outcome is non-interpretable; repair execution on the same frozen backbone without changing equations, thresholds, seeds, or scientific rules.
